KiteConfig 3.0.0 now works in Kotlin Toolchain projects (the `./kotlin` command with `project.yaml` and `module.yaml`). It generates `KiteBuildConfig`, writes the Xcode project and checks the Android settings, with the same build numbers as the Gradle plugin. The Gradle API is unchanged, and one break still compiles: some failures now throw a different exception type.

## Usage

```kotlin
// Gradle projects
plugins {
    id("io.github.yuroyami.kiteconfig") version "3.0.0"
}
```

For a Kotlin Toolchain project, copy `toolchain/kiteconfig/` into your project and point its `module.yaml` at this release:

```yaml
repositories:
  - id: gradlePluginPortal
    url: https://plugins.gradle.org/m2

dependencies:
  - io.github.yuroyami:kiteconfig:3.0.0
```

The Toolchain cannot load a published plugin, so the plugin module lives in your project. [toolchain/README.md](https://github.com/yuroyami/KiteConfig/blob/v3.0.0/toolchain/README.md) has the full setup.

## Changelog

### Breaking changes

| Change | What to do |
|:--|:--|
| [820004f](https://github.com/yuroyami/KiteConfig/commit/820004f): Some build failures now throw `KiteConfigException` (a `RuntimeException`) instead of `GradleException` | Catch `RuntimeException` if your build logic catches `GradleException` around KiteConfig values |

This break still compiles. The build fails with the same message as before.

## Dependencies

| | Version |
|:--|:--|
| Gradle | **8.5** or newer (9.5.1 built with) |
| Kotlin Gradle plugin | **2.4.x** stable (2.4.21 built with) |
| Android Gradle plugin | **8.5.2** through **9.3.x** |
| Kotlin Toolchain | 0.13.0 (`toolchain/kiteconfig`) |
| JDK | 17 or 21 to run Gradle (21 built with), JVM bytecode 17 |

Targets: Android, iOS and desktop apps through Gradle. In a Kotlin Toolchain project: `KiteBuildConfig`, the Xcode project and the Android settings check. Icons, launch screens, `Info.plist` changes and desktop packaging stay Gradle only.

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/yuroyami/KiteConfig/compare/v2.1.0...v3.0.0
